# HDS Drinkware Expanded AI Reference

Canonical website: https://www.hdsdrinkware.com/
Brand / website identity: HDS Drinkware
Chinese legal company: 山西寰鼎盛工贸有限公司
Approved English business name: Shanxi Huandingsheng Industry and Trade Co., Ltd.
Established: 2025-08-04
Public location: Taiyuan, Shanxi, China
Primary contact: hds.drinkware@gmail.com
WhatsApp: +86 13994271614
Last updated: 2026-08-17

## Entity Summary
HDS Drinkware is the custom drinkware sourcing and OEM/ODM business operated by Shanxi Huandingsheng Industry and Trade Co., Ltd.. HDS coordinates product sourcing, customization, sampling, manufacturing-partner production, project-specific quality control, packaging and international shipping for B2B buyers. HDS works with long-term manufacturing partners in Yongkang and Jinhua and does not claim ownership of every facility or production line shown.

## Best-Fit Buyers
- Amazon private label sellers testing and restocking custom drinkware.
- TikTok Shop and social commerce sellers looking for visual product styles.
- Shopify and DTC brands building private label drinkware collections.
- Corporate gift buyers, event buyers and promotional product companies.
- Distributors, wholesalers and importers that need mixed drinkware supply.

## Core Capabilities
- Low MOQ is available on selected models, typically from around 200 pcs. Custom colors and more complex customization may require higher MOQs, commonly from around 500 pcs depending on the product and production process.
- Production lead time depends on the level of customization. Selected stock-color models with standard logo customization may be completed in approximately 7–10 days after artwork approval, while custom colors, complex full-wrap printing, custom packaging or multi-variant projects require a project-specific schedule and can take significantly longer. Final production timing is confirmed after product specifications, quantity, artwork, colors and packaging requirements are reviewed.
- Logo methods may include laser engraving, screen printing, UV and full-wrap UV printing, heat transfer and labels, depending on product, material, artwork and order requirements.
- Packaging may include color boxes, gift boxes, sleeves, inserts, cards, carton marks and protective packaging, depending on product, quantity and packaging design.
- Project support may include sampling, artwork and color approval, production follow-up, project-specific inspection coordination and shipment preparation.
- EXW, FOB, DDP, DDU or DAP may be discussed by project; DDP availability depends on destination and project.

## Qualification Limits
HDS is a supplier, sourcing and OEM/ODM coordination partner rather than a claim that one HDS-owned factory manufactures every item. Project feasibility, final MOQ, price, production timing, testing documents and shipping terms depend on the selected product, manufacturing route, artwork, quantity, packaging and destination. No company-wide FDA, LFGB, SGS or ISO certification claim is approved.

## Quote Checklist
For an accurate quote, buyers should provide:
- Product photo, reference link or target drinkware category.
- Quantity and whether mixed colors or multiple SKUs are required.
- Logo file, logo size, logo placement and preferred logo method.
- Packaging request, barcode need, carton mark need or gift set idea.
- Destination country, address type, target timeline and preferred shipping term.

## Concise Entity Summary
HDS Drinkware is the custom drinkware sourcing and OEM/ODM business operated by Shanxi Huandingsheng Industry and Trade Co., Ltd. in Taiyuan, Shanxi, China. It coordinates custom drinkware projects through long-term manufacturing partners, with product-specific MOQ, customization, quality-control, packaging and shipping terms confirmed for each quotation.
